{{Quote|Great fear in you there is, since the death of your master. Much honored was Casieck Akinslesh. Honored, and now missed.|Yoda, to Orykan Tamarik|<ref name="DS1" />}}
'''Casieck Akinslesh''' was a respected member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Akinslesh's [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]] was mourned by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], as well as [[Orykan Tamarik]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Akinslesh had been [[Jedi training/Legends|training]]. The loss of her [[Jedi Master/Legends|master]] left Tamarik concerned and fearful. In the wake of Akinslesh's death, Tamarik was temporarily assigned to Jedi Master [[Tahl]].<ref name="DS1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Casieck Akinslesh was first mentioned in the [[Jedi — The Dark Side 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Jedi — The Dark Side|''Star Wars: Jedi—The Dark Side'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series.<ref name="DS1" /> The issue was written by [[Scott Allie]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 18]], [[2011]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54280/star_wars_jedi_-_the_dark_side_2011_1|text=Star Wars: Jedi - The Dark Side (2011) #1}}</ref>
